title: Add Support for EIP-7939 (CLZ Opcode) in the FEVM
description: Adds support for EIP-7939 (Count Leading Zeros opcode) in the FEVM, providing native bitwise operation support for efficient computation.

storageProviders: Enables more efficient data processing routines in FEVM contracts
clients: Benefits from reduced computation costs in storage-related smart contracts
tokenHolders: No direct impact on FIL token economics
applicationDevelopers: Provides native CLZ opcode support for bit manipulation in FEVM contracts
Improves efficiency for cryptographic and data compression operations
